SRES 630.title: A resolution honoring the lives of fallen Missouri police officers and expressing condolences to their families.

description.summary: Honors the lives of fallen Missouri police officers and expresses condolences to their families. It is a ceremonial resolution aimed at Missouri law enforcement personnel who have died and their families; the available text is brief and does not propose changes to statutes, funding, or government operations.

impact.summary: This Senate resolution would formally honor the lives of Missouri police officers who have died and express condolences to their surviving family members. It would directly concern those officers' families and the Missouri law enforcement community—such as the Missouri State Highway Patrol and municipal police departments (for example, the St. Louis and Kansas City police)—and would become an official statement entered into the U.S. Senate record as it is considered by the Senate Judiciary Committee.
